events.scope: Preserve membership, checkpoint/probe/fingerprint identities, admission ages and health window; no old q conversion

ratings.scope: Independent held-out evidence; never a sampling score

entropy_control.scope: Final raw policy on fixed IL probe; prospective post-warmup baseline, no retired IL action checks

branching.scope: Continuation outcomes/actions only; excluded from ordinary health, PFSP, ratings and progress

exploration_metrics.scope: Actual latent exploration picks in nonforced ordinary action-phase decisions; learner and neural snapshot seats. Single-choice picks and pass-only positions reported separately (a pass-only position may have several discard choices).

quality_pool.scope: Unweighted learner/snapshot pairs in completed history tables only; p/IL share used are frozen before collection. Decayed rates are training diagnostics, not PL strength.

measurement.scope: Fixed IL validation positions; raw temperature-1 policies, no exploration; symmetric floor/renormalization for KL

health.scope: All-learner self-play: seat-weighted five-iteration VP, ordinary passes, zero-VP and insolvency rates. No IL action-probability checks; sales are reporting only.

lr_gate.scope: Fixed raw IL validation probe and calibrated all-learner health

rehearsal_schedule.scope: Weight for the next collection/update, using configured hold and interval at committed progress

value_phase.scope: Critic: current plus configured previous iteration; validation/cloning/probes: current only; separate Adam/configured value LR, no PPO counters; KL-safe prefixes require non-increasing held-out loss

train_before.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

train_after.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

heldout_before.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

heldout_after.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

last_attempted_heldout.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

value_phase.heldout_attempt_scope: Safe interval/prefix after any violating step is restored

heldout_unknown.scope: MC loss over all heldout heads; gate EV and table/role evidence use ordinary games. Branch/ordinary EV reported separately; correlated rows/heads

split.scope: Outcome-independent hash ranking within table type; complete games excluded from all critic fits and caches; actor still uses these games. Rare strata oversampled in held-out diagnostics.

weight_recovery.scope: Five consecutive healthy, actually trained iterations at each weight; EV at least the fixed phase-1 baseline. Changes apply next iteration; no historical backfill

critic_rollout.scope: Actual retained PPO/PPG snapshot exposure required; counts per phase may overlap. Sequential heldout diagnostic, not a causal snapshot benefit estimate

sampling.scope: Actual completed tables and learner seats; forced decisions are critic-only. Table fractions do not define PPO sample fractions.

legacy_profiles.scope: Actual completed ordinary legacy seats; pottery-flex remains evaluation-only

curriculum.scope: Ordinary game tables only; teacher/evaluation games and optimizer steps do not advance this clock

branch_sample_usage.scope: Distinct branch continuation rows in retained PPO steps; branch move and prefix excluded

gae.scope: Raw pre-normalization nonforced learner decisions; critic targets remain Monte Carlo

historical.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
historical.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at each iteration's accepted post-value weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

historical.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and no value KL trip; accepted value steps supported across the mixed-table EV window
